note: Every dataset below was read through an HTTP fetch of the live official page on the stated date. The transcription in data/raw/*.csv is the record of what the page said; pipelines/validate.py re-checks internal consistency and cross-file agreement. 'chunk' is the chunk index of the rendered page that was read, so a reviewer can land on the same text.

datasets.source_title: Official Latest NFL Injury Report for Players - Week 10 of the 2026 Season | NFL.com
datasets.notes: All 8 rendered chunks. Rows with an empty Game Status are printed on the official page that way and stay empty here.
Two of the page's 16 positional columns could not be mapped to a Legend label; those columns are not published (flags F-07).

datasets.source_title: NFL Schedules: Games, Times, Matchups & Tickets | NFL.com (2026, Week 10)

datasets.notes: Composite lines that render as concatenated digits are not transcribed (flags F-05).

One club roster page read as an independent confirmation of club assignment. 8 of 9 spot-checks could not be confirmed because the matching club roster pages were not read this session; they stay UNCONFIRMED.
No free, official, machine-readable depth chart exists. This is the single most consequential gap in the project (flags F-01).

datasets.result: No official NFL source for betting lines exists. The NFL does not publish spreads, totals, moneylines or player-prop prices.
datasets.notes: Market columns are therefore blank on every data page and flagged (flags F-02).
